descriptionHtml:
Bug B01 · P0 · new

Photo census scan never finds anyone: the vision model wraps its JSON in a ```json block and parseModelJson (convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98) silently returns nothing (Hospital and Nursing Home)

Tickets: TFA-94425 ready for qa; TFA-92580 rejected by qa; TFA-92587 AC 3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Also blocks dev U77; U78–U81 paused for the same reason Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92587): it also blocks every Nursing Home scan case on dev (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S08, S17, S18; dev units U77–U81 paused).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-03/S18, TC-09/S04, TC-09/S06, TC-09/S07, TC-09/S17, TC-09/S18

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S08 A resident on today's list who is not on the photo is not dropped from today without a word

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 3; TFA-92587 How it works 3)
  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 2; TFA-92587 How it works 2; TFA-92587 How it works 6)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fixture resident In Today (MRN 'QA-<tag>-10'); QA Alder (Oak 1, MRN 'QA-<tag>-01') in All Residents, not In Today; no date of birth anywhere (D5)

When Scan a one-row photo listing only QA Alder, confirm, then check Today's Visits and All Residents

Then Per the UAT ('the photo adds residents') and AC 3 ('never silently dropping'): QA Alder joins Today's Visits, and the fixture resident is still on Today's Visits. Both stay in All Residents

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: s08-today contains QA Alder and {snfResident} and mustNotContain 'In Today ✓', so a checkpoint saved on All Residents cannot pass (U2 'the photo adds residents to Today's Visits'); s08-all contains both and 'In Today ✓' (U5 never deleted). Judged against the UAT wording. …

Where it ran: dev unit U77; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Blocked by a product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92587 ready for qa; TFA-94425 ready for qa

On dev, a clear one-row census photo comes back as 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.', so the test could not check whether a resident who is not on the photo gets silently dropped from Today's Visits.

Evidence: allure 32fce1c4: the agent stopped at the scan error with 4 of 5 checkpoints not reached. Ledger U77: Gemini wraps the JSON in a ```json fence, and vision.scanCensusSheet parses it with a bare JSON.parse (convex/ai/vision.ts:49 -> convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98), so 0 rows come back. Reproduced locally. The same bug pauses U78-U81 (TC-09 S04/S06/S07/S17). Once unblocked, S08 is judged against 'adds' (TC-09 Q1, add vs replace, Daniela).

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

Plan said: not-runnable-on-dev: permission-add-patient, synthetic-media — this run has a result anyway, so the result is shown.
